01 What are the costs of a luxury wellness or mental health retreat program? All retreats at Alive are private, fully customised, and delivered one on one and perfectly curated for VIP's and high networth individuals. Each program is designed around you, combining our holistic 360 degree approach across health, mind, and lifestyle. While we offer four core focus areas, wellness, detox, burnout recovery, and mental health, most guests blend elements across multiple areas to create a truly personalised experience. Your retreat is set within a five star beachfront environment, with the choice of a private luxury pool villa or an ultra exclusive private residence, depending on your level of privacy and space required. Pricing begins from $1,980 USD per night, all inclusive. Final investment varies depending on your program design, level of support, and accommodation choice. 02 What programs does Alive Luxury Retreats offer? Alive Luxury Wellness Retreats offers a range of private one on one high end holistic wellness retreat programs designed to support your health, wellbeing and lifestyle. Each retreat is personalised, meaning your program can combine elements from several focus areas depending on your goals. All Alive retreats take a whole person approach. Signature 360 Wellness Retreat Our Signature 360 Wellness Retreat is the foundation of the Alive experience and is designed for complete health and wellbeing renewal. It is included in every retreat package. This all-inclusive wellness retreat includes luxury accommodation, nourishing cuisine or detox menus, daily yoga, meditation and fitness, healing sessions, inspiring life and health coaching, spa and massage, nature and adventure experiences and guided support from the Alive team. Guests often choose this program when they want to reset their health, increase energy, improve fitness, build healthier habits and experience deep rest within a luxury wellness retreat environment working exclusively with the team and within their own private villa. Minimum stay: 5 nights Detox and Cleanse Retreat The Detox and Cleanse Retreat focuses on restoring balance and helping the body gently detoxify after periods of stress, unhealthy habits or low energy. Guests follow a personalised detox or cleanse approach supported by ultra tailored detox protocols and thorough health analysis, natural health sessions, movement, spa treatments, bodywork, recovery sessions, executive life coaching and healing practices. Many guests choose this retreat to feel lighter, clearer and more energised while learning sustainable habits for long term wellbeing, recover from health issues and cleanse the body, mind and soul at the same time. Minimum stay: 7+ nights recommended Longevity and Biohacking Retreat (see detox program) The Longevity and Biohacking Retreat is designed for guests who want to focus on advanced health optimisation and physical rejuvenation. Combined with the Signature 360 Wellness Retreat or Detox programs, this retreat includes therapies such as IV nutrient therapy, ozone treatments and other biohacking approaches that support cellular health, energy and recovery. Guests often combine these treatments with nutrition, movement, recovery therapies and wellness coaching for a complete health reset. Minimum stay: 7+ nights Stress and Burnout Recovery Retreat The Stress and Burnout Recovery Retreat is a powerful 360 reset for those who have been pushing too hard for too long and know something needs to change. This program goes far beyond rest and relaxation. Guests work privately with a team of experienced executive coaches, healers and wellness professionals to rapidly reduce stress, restore health and rebuild energy while addressing the deeper patterns that led to burnout in the first place. During your retreat you work one-on-one with the Alive team across every area of life including health, habits, mindset, emotional wellbeing, purpose and lifestyle. The Alive process supports you to reset your body, clear your mind, reconnect with what matters and create meaningful changes that can be implemented immediately both during your stay and when you return to the real world. Guests often arrive exhausted, overwhelmed or disconnected from themselves and leave with renewed health, clarity, direction and the tools to live and lead in a far more balanced and sustainable way. Recommended minimum stay for best results: 10-21 nights Mental Health Retreat The Emotional Wellbeing Retreat is designed for guests navigating significant life pressure, emotional overwhelm or major life transitions who need more than a simple wellness break. This program provides a complete reset across health, mindset, emotional wellbeing and life direction. Guests work privately with experienced holistic counsellors, coaches, healers and wellness experts to address anxiety, severe stress, depression, emotional fatigue and the deeper patterns of trauma affecting how they live and feel. During the retreat you are supported one-on-one across multiple areas including emotional healing, mindset, relationships, habits, health and lifestyle. The focus is not only on feeling better in the moment but creating real change that can be sustained when you return home. Many guests arrive feeling lost, overwhelmed or disconnected from themselves and leave with renewed clarity, emotional strength and a clear path forward in both life and wellbeing. Recommended minimum stay for best results: 14-28 nights Relationship Recovery Retreat Alive also offers private Relationship Recovery Retreats for couples or families seeking support to reconnect, resolve conflict and strengthen communication. These retreats are delivered privately with experienced facilitators and are designed to help partners or families rebuild trust, improve communication and create stronger relationships while enjoying the privacy and support of a luxury retreat environment. The Full Alive 360 Health, Mind and Life Transformation The Full Alive 360 Transformation is our most comprehensive and profound program, designed for guests who want to complete the full Alive journey with the support of the entire wellness team. This highly customised program integrates every aspect of wellbeing and transformation including: Body Nutrition, detox and cleanse protocols, fitness and movement training, yoga, spa and recovery therapies, naturopathy, biohacking and health optimisation. Mind Coaching, mindset work, mindfulness, meditation and tools to create clarity, resilience and mental focus. Heart Emotional healing, relationship work, compassion practices and support to release past patterns. Soul Deep reflection, spiritual connection, nature immersion and practices that reconnect you with meaning and presence. Purpose Vision work, life direction, goal alignment and creating a lifestyle that reflects who you truly are. This program is deeply personalised and delivered privately with the Alive team, allowing you to experience a complete reset of health, mindset, emotional wellbeing and life direction. Minimum stay: 21 days Are all programs personalised? Yes. Every Alive retreat program is customised, one on one with your expert team working with you and only you. Guests often combine elements of several programs. Your retreat is designed around your needs before arrival and refined throughout your stay to ensure you receive the right level of support and care.

mainEntity.name: What are Alive Luxury Retreats and who are they for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Alive Luxury Retreats offers luxury private retreats delivered one on one and fully customised. Since 2009, we have specialised in a holistic approach across health, mind, and lifestyle for high performing individuals, executives, entrepreneurs, and high net worth clients seeking privacy, discretion, and real results.

mainEntity.name: What retreat programs do you offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: We offer four core retreat focuses: 360 Wellness, Detox and Health Reset, De Stress and Burnout Recovery, and Mental Health and Emotional Healing. All retreats are private and fully personalised, with most clients blending elements across multiple areas to create a tailored experience.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the 360 Wellness retreat?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 360 Wellness retreat focuses on deep relaxation, health optimisation, movement, spa, longevity, and overall wellbeing. It includes private sessions, personalised support, refined dining, five star accommodation, and a fully integrated approach to restoring balance and energy.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the Detox retreat?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Detox and Health Reset retreat focuses on advanced detox, biohacking, and lifestyle change. It includes all elements of the 360 Wellness program along with customised detox protocols, nutritional cleansing, mental detox, emotional release, and personalised coaching.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the Burnout recovery retreat?

acceptedAnswer.text: The De Stress and Burnout Recovery retreat combines wellness and detox with deeper coaching, healing, and full life reset work. It is designed to restore energy, reduce pressure, and support long term change across health, mindset, and lifestyle.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the Mental Health retreat?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Mental Health and Emotional Healing retreat builds on wellness and detox with deeper one on one therapy, trauma work, and emotional healing. It supports clarity, stability, and long term wellbeing through a private and structured approach.

mainEntity.name: Are the retreats private and personalised?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All retreats are delivered one on one and fully customised. Each program is designed around your specific needs, with a high level of privacy, discretion, and personalised support throughout your stay.

mainEntity.name: What are the costs of a retreat?

acceptedAnswer.text: All retreats are private and fully customised. Pricing begins from $1,980 USD per night, all inclusive. Final investment depends on your program design, level of support, and accommodation choice.

mainEntity.name: How do I book or request a personalised quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: The next step is to book a confidential call or request a personalised quote. Our team will design your private retreat experience based on your needs and goals.
